patthana23.9:1.1: Nakusalaṃ naācayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha.
patthana23.9:2.1: Nakusalaṃ naapacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo apacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.9:3.1: Nakusalaṃ nanevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā pañca.
